Just read your piece How To Get Clients as a Personal Trainer. Small thing, but the "Try online booking for free!" block and "Related Posts" both seem to appear twice on the page.

Tip 12 says to show client progress on social media. I run a motion studio, and I'd be happy to make a short form-demo video for the social media tips, free.

In return, just a credit link back to motiontheagency.com, or we'll pay for placement instead.

Would you be open to exploring this?

Cheers,
Sam
